item.title: Illegal and polluting waste dischage, 30th July
item.description:
You will see in the photos the drain that is being used by builders and painters to dispose of their chemical, paint,plaster, adhesive etc. It has been going on for weeks now and I know it has been mentioned to them. The scaffolders have also been playing really loud music and swearing. The scaffolding company is called No8 and they turned the radio up when asked if they would turn it down. The health and safety on this site is terrible, They have been cutting dry and no extract or any attempt to protect the public from dangerous silica dust. They need a visit from H&S

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Fauconberg Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
